args.query: hospital financial data rural hospital operating margin

sql: SELECT fiscal_year, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN net_income_from_patient_services<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) loss_pat, sum(CASE WHEN net_income<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) loss_total FROM health.hospital_cost_report_financials WHERE state='OK' AND rural_urban='R' GROUP BY fiscal_year ORDER BY fiscal_year

SELECT t.provider_number, t.facility_name, t.termination_code, t.termination_date, f.bed_count FROM health.cms_pos_termination_history t LEFT JOIN health.cms_pos_facilities f ON f.provider_number=t.provider_number WHERE t.state='OK' AND t.provider_category_code='01' AND t.termination_date>=DATE '2015-01-01' ORDER BY t.termination_date
